answer: The willow peeler works the brake with his foot, and the rhythm of the work is the rhythm of the shed. Reed rattan cane weaver weave charter is the working: a charter rattan cane weavers hold after weaving shed inspections. The beacon is the first rhythm kept, the echo the last before the shed falls quiet, and the sparrow is the quiet, the brake still on its bench. A forger faces 13 false rhythms and 13 false quiets.
